title: Brutal Sour Strawberry Bubblegum Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid By Just Juice
description: Brutal's Sour Strawberry Bubblegum e-liquid is a deliciously smooth and sweet candy flavour that will transport you back in time with its rich, fruity strawberry bubblegum juiciness. The irresistible sour notes on the exhale add an extra burst of flavour, making it an unforgettable taste experience. Conjure up sunny sensory memories of yesteryear with every inhale, as the juicy strawberry flavour and sour notes combine to create a rich and flavourful journey. Brutal's range of nic salt e-liquids offers a perfect balance of flavour, vapour production, and throat hit with their 50VG/50PG blend. Designed for e-cigarette starter kits and pod vape devices, these e-liquids come in 11mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, making them an excellent choice for vapers who seek immediate relief from nicotine cravings. Nicotine Salt e-liquids have a unique alkaline formulation that delivers a higher concentration of nicotine compared to regular freebase e-liquids. They provide a smooth throat hit at higher nicotine concentrations and are absorbed faster into the bloodstream. As a result, these e-liquids are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking satisfying nicotine relief with a smooth throat hit. Brutal e-liquid is a delicious new collection of e-liquids from UK's e-juice masters Just Juice. They are available in long-lasting 100ml shortfills and intensely satisfying Nic Salts. The range features five classic sweetshop flavours that are sure to light up your taste buds in a glow of warm memories. Brutal e-liquid's nostalgic favourites include Rhubarb and Custard, Red & Black's raspberry and blackcurrant gummies, Mr Jack's liquorice and aniseed, Sour Strawberry Bubblegum, and Raspberry Sour chew bars. Each Brutal vape flavour will transport you back to the carefree days of childhood when a visit to the tuck shop was the highlight of the day.
